description: Canonical AI Capability Model for SYNTH Platform v1.0. Single source of truth for agent skills, IDE rules, MCP manifests, and documentation projections.

platform.name: SYNTH
platform.tagline: Deterministic execution system for engineering work. Humans explore, SYNTH remembers, and AI executes deterministically.

concepts.name: Mission
concepts.definition: A strategic goal you want to achieve.
concepts.example: Build a customer support portal that lets users track tickets.

concepts.name: Expedition
concepts.definition: A bounded investigation or build that moves a mission forward.
concepts.example: Design the authentication flow for the support portal.

concepts.name: Evidence
concepts.definition: What you know and how confidently you know it.
concepts.example: User interviews show 80% of support requests are password resets.

concepts.name: Plan
concepts.definition: The approved path forward, including the work to do.
concepts.example: Approved plan: implement login page, session management, and password reset.

concepts.name: Event
concepts.definition: An immutable record that something happened.
concepts.example: Mission approved. Expedition started. Objective completed.

concepts.name: State
concepts.definition: The current picture of the world, derived from events.
concepts.example: The support portal mission is active, the authentication expedition is executing.

concepts.name: Replay
concepts.definition: Rebuilding state from events to prove correctness.
concepts.example: Replay the event log to verify that the current state matches the history.

publicVocabulary.rule: Use exactly these seven concepts in public-facing explanations. Everything else is implementation detail.

classes.name: READ_ONLY
classes.description: Never mutates repository or governance state. Safe at any time.

classes.name: PROPOSAL_ONLY
classes.description: Produces a proposal but does not mutate state. Safe during discovery.

classes.name: POTENTIALLY_MUTATING
classes.description: May mutate state depending on flags. Not safe during discovery without explicit approval.

classes.name: MUTATING
classes.description: Mutates repository or governance state. Requires explicit approval.

commands.description: Discover repository structure and produce a read-only analysis
Explain operations (replay, lineage, proposals, snapshots, graph, diagnostics, status, identity, resume, governance, all)
Verify governance invariants and projection consistency
Run failure and recovery certification scenarios
Generate a bootstrap proposal without mutating state
Extract intent and create a first-contact proposal draft
Show or apply clarification answers to the draft
Project architecture candidates from the draft
Verify capability assumptions for the selected architecture
Transform a repository into a Synth project (mutating only with --approve)
Apply bootstrap and initialize governance artifacts
Initialize the current directory as a Synth project
Commit approved Expedition intent to runtime
Run the complete canonical governance pipeline
Materialize the approved artifact into a SYNTH project

commandSafety.rule: During Discovery, only READ_ONLY and PROPOSAL_ONLY commands are permitted.

assets.name: Mission Studio
assets.description: Read-only planning environment; sole authority for transforming evidence into approved Mission Models.

assets.name: Genesis
assets.description: Authority for committing approved Mission Models to the Kernel through the single mutation authority.

assets.name: Replay
assets.description: Mechanism for rebuilding state from events to prove correctness and detect tampering.

assets.name: ExecutionGate
assets.description: Single mutation authority through which all persistent state changes flow.

assets.name: Event Model
assets.description: Canonical structure and semantics of immutable events.

assets.name: Capability Model
assets.description: Registry of system capabilities and their public contracts.

assets.name: Constitutional Baseline
assets.description: Architectural provisions defining the foundations of the system.

assets.name: Public Vocabulary
assets.description: The seven public concepts used to explain SYNTH.

protectedAssets.rule: Any change to a Protected Asset requires an Architecture Expedition and a new ADR.

phases.name: draft
phases.description: Intent is captured but not yet approved.

phases.name: approved
phases.description: Intent is approved and ready to commit.

phases.name: committed
phases.description: Intent is committed to runtime state.

phases.name: completed
phases.description: Work is finished and evidence is recorded.

governanceLifecycle.rule: Expeditions are the canonical governance mechanism for all architectural work.

workflows.name: Discovery
workflows.description: Produce a read-only analysis of a repository without mutating state.

workflows.name: Bootstrap
workflows.description: Transform a repository into a SYNTH-governed project.
steps: Run 'synth bootstrap --dry-run' to generate a proposal.

workflows.name: Mission Lifecycle
workflows.description: Create, approve, and track a strategic goal.
workflows.invariant: Mission approval requires explicit review evidence.

workflows.name: Expedition Lifecycle
workflows.description: Execute bounded architectural work within a Mission.
workflows.invariant: Expedition state transitions through the ExecutionGate.

workflows.name: Governance Pipeline
workflows.description: Run the full canonical validation and proof pipeline.
workflows.invariant: The governance pipeline is deterministic and reproducible.

workflows.name: First Contact / Genesis
workflows.description: Greenfield onboarding workflow for new projects.
steps: Run 'synth genesis start' to capture intent.
Run 'synth genesis clarify' to refine understanding.
Run 'synth genesis project' to review architecture candidates.
Run 'synth genesis verify' to validate assumptions.
Run 'synth genesis approve' and 'synth genesis materialize --approve' to create the project.
